title: lab 105 - 2026

lab_objective.description: By the end of this lab, you will be able to understand S3 object storage, create and configure S3 bucket and managing bucket policy and object ACLs
lab_objective.scenario: Your company plans to store application files and business documents in Amazon S3. As the AWS Administrator, your task is to create a secure S3 bucket, upload the required files, configure bucket permissions, and grant appropriate access to authorized users while following AWS security best practices.
employees: john - Application Team - Upload and download files
sarah - Public Website Team -  Manage public objects
objectives: Understand Amazon S3 object storage concepts.
Create and configure an S3 bucket.
Upload objects to an S3 bucket.
Configure S3 Block Public Access settings.
Test access permissions using different IAM users.
Apply the Principle of Least Privilege.
Delete S3 resources to avoid unnecessary charges.

tasks.title: Login to AWS Management Console
steps: Login to AWS Console using the Root account.
Cool!!! After login you will see the AWS Console.

tasks.title: Select AWS Region
steps: Keep the same region throughout the lab

tasks.title: Create a new S3 Bucket
steps: Make sure AWS Region is US East (N. Virginia) us-east-1.

tasks.title: Configure Object Ownership
steps: AWS recommends using IAM Policies and Bucket Policies instead of ACLs.

tasks.title: Configure Public Access Settings
steps: This setting Protects bucket from accidental public exposure.

tasks.title: Create Bucket and Verify
steps: Verify bucket is available in S3 Console.

tasks.title: Upload any three Objects to S3 Bucket
steps: Choose any three pictures or objects and rename these pictures 1) public.jpg 2) private.jpg 3) backup.jpg
Verify files are visible inside the bucket.

tasks.title: Test Public Access
steps: Copy URL of public.png and open browser
Expected result - File content should be display

tasks.title: Configure IAM User Access
steps: Create following groups and attach polices according to given instructions
Create following user and add to Group

tasks.title: Test IAM Permissions
steps: Login to user 'john', Upload any Object, Expected - Allowed
try to delete same object, Expected - Allowed
Cool!! it turns out 'AmazonS3FullAccess' allows upload and delete objects
Login to user 'sarah', Download any Object, Expected - Allowed
try to upload any object, Expected - Denied
try to delete any object, Expected - Denied
Cool!! it turns out 'AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess' allows dowload object but do not allow upload and delete objects
Wow!! we can manage access on S3 bucket using IAM user access

tasks.title: Configure Object ACL
steps: Navigate to Bucket, Object, and Permissions
1) Select object ACL, 2) Enable ACLs, 3)  Grant Everyone - Read Access
Expected - Object should be accessible publicly

tasks.title: Enable Block Public Access
steps: Navigate to Bucket, Object, Permissions and Block Public Access
